description: Election Commission - Procedure for Casting Vote Where there is a Reasonable Fear of an Inability to Cast Vote at a given Poling Station
reasoning: This gazette content specifically outlines procedures for casting votes in the Presidential Election 2024 under Section 119B of the Presidential Elections Act. It provides details about application procedures, deadlines, and requirements for voters who fear inability to vote at their designated polling stations. The content focuses entirely on electoral processes and procedures, falling clearly under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers election announcements, procedures, voter registration matters, and electoral commission communications.
